source_row.rationale: Closed-loop communication — in which the receiver repeats back an order or instruction, and the sender confirms it was correctly received — is an evidence-based communication technique particularly valuable in high-stakes, time-critical situations like emergencies/codes, helping reduce the risk of miscommunication-related errors.
source_row.source_detail: Three-step closed loop: sender initiates, receiver confirms, sender verifies; last reviewed 2023-05; accessed 2026-08-14.
